definitions.full: H5530. sakal סָכָל noun masculine fool (on formation compare Lag BN 48 ): — Jer 5:21 ; Eccl 2:19 ; 7:17 ; 10:3 (twice in verse); 10:14 ; plural adjective סְכָלִים Jer 4:22 .
